versions.changelog:
Initial release of Email Manager Pro, a comprehensive AI email attendant for OpenClaw agents.

- Processes and organizes emails across priority, waiting reply, newsletters, spam, and processed/archive folders.
- Proactive email sorting, spam filtering, and important message highlighting using built-in rule sets.
- Supports scheduled email checks (default every 30 minutes), with user-controllable check intervals.
- Handles folder creation for newsletters and by user request; suggests new folders based on patterns but never creates without approval.
- Tracks and logs critical emails for notifications and daily summaries.
- Requires an existing connected email MCP or tool (does not set up mailbox connections).
